description: A dated, georeferenced 3D model of a site (entity_type + id, or lat + lng) with measurements: extent, elevation, slope, pits and heaps with volumes. The tier (lidar_2m or dem_30m) is decided before any charge. Slow (about 15–60 s). Agent keys only. Metered: see CHARGING in the server instructions; quote first with `billing_quote`.

as_of.description: Pick the lidar collection and texture nearest this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

entity_type.description: Entity kind: deposit | infrastructure | company | project. With id; or pass lat + lng.

include_model.description: Also return the binary glTF model as model_glb_base64 (a lidar model is about 5 MB as base64).

radius_m.description: Half the square's side, in metres, 100-1000. Default 300.

name: site_reconstruction
